slides.title: Dock Harness
slides.subtitle: Does this prediction support the claim?
slides.notes: The harness decides whether a co-folding or docking result can support a declared claim. Example system throughout: bovine trypsin, PDB 3PTB, with benzamidine.

slides.title: 12 perturbed poses: valid on confidence, rejected with the harness
slides.footer: S1: media/figures/twelve/twelve.json; bench/runs/*/report.md. S2: Kim et al. 2026 [R2]. Refs: R4, R16, R23–R26
slides.notes: Columns: CDK2 1B38, FtsE 8X61, MEK1 7XLP, glucose dehydrogenase 2VWH. Rows: runs 1 to 3. Red spheres mark pocket residues cut to glycine; glucose dehydrogenase has its ligand hydroxyls methylated instead. Without the harness means the agent saw only ligand ipTM and pocket pLDDT; with the harness it saw the fact file. Published AUC: AlphaFold3 ligand pLDDT, 489 Mac1 complexes.
